name: domain-driven-design
description: Domain-driven-design practice skills. Today it owns a consuming project's ubiquitous-language glossary: finds and reads it for other skills, seeds a first one from the code with a person accepting each term, resolves ambiguous or overloaded terms, records canonical language and rejected synonyms, and checks code, copy and error messages for rejected words, within already-known bounded contexts.

glossary_file.title: Glossary file name
glossary_file.description: File name ubiquitous-language proposes for a bounded context's glossary when the repository has no glossary convention. A file name, never a path. docs/conventions/domain-driven-design.yaml overrides this.

glossary_map_file.title: Glossary index file name
glossary_map_file.description: File name ubiquitous-language proposes for the root glossary index once more than one bounded context exists. A file name, never a path. docs/conventions/domain-driven-design.yaml overrides this.
